_why: Operator 2026-10-16 (process consolidation): stop continuous shadow rehearsals for accepted production lanes; keep purposeful regression and canary dry runs after relevant changes. Read by scripts/lib/n8n_shadow_policy.py and scripts/report_n8n_shadow_policy.py (READ-ONLY planners). mode 'report' is the only mode: nothing here changes a dispatch row, a cron slot, the relay live-lanes list or the executor. Wiring a canary into the dispatcher, and every cadence change below, is a registry-row PR the operator rules on (AGENTS.md §17, §23.11).

accepted._why: An accepted production lane: registry dispatch.mode live at scheduler.stage canary or cutover, with at least one live RUN_DONE. Measured 2026-10-09..16: such lanes already get NO continuous dry runs (n8n_due emits one mode per lane per slot; PR #1822 pins it); 0 dry runs after the first live RUN_DONE on any accepted lane.

regression_canary._why: A purposeful dry run of an accepted lane, due only when something that can change its behaviour changed since its last verified live run (receipt code_sha): its own config (registry row, allowlist entry, health contract) or its entry script. A new release SHA that touches neither does not make a canary due unless any_release is true.

shadow_cadence_proposals._why: PROPOSAL ONLY (operator §17: promotion/retirement and cadence of these shadow lanes is the operator's call). Measured 2026-10-09T17:30Z..2026-10-16T17:30Z from data/runtime/n8n_runs; output_changes = consecutive dry runs whose normalized stdout tail differed (timestamps and floats stripped).

momentum-cache-reconcile.rationale: Projects momentum candidates that only move in market hours; overnight and weekend fires re-project an unchanged input. 288/day -> 44/weekday.

momentum-lifecycle-monitor.rationale: Every tail differs because the monitor stamps its own NOT_MEASURED/OVERSIZED status block, not because its inputs move; inputs are scalp-cycle artifacts written in market hours. 288/day -> 44/weekday.

hermes-score-event-feeder.rationale: The dry run prints one constant line ('would collect research events, enqueue scoring work and write a run receipt'): 0 output changes in 1,357 runs. Each further run proves only that the process starts. Hourly keeps the liveness proof; a real promotion check needs a dry run that reports what it would enqueue (code PR), not more fires. 288/day -> 24/day.

scalp-hot-list.rationale: Dry run reason dry_run_no_refresh: it lists the screeners it would run, which change only when the refresh receipt does. 120/weekday -> 24/weekday, same 06:00-09:59 window.

finviz-enrichment-scalp-hot.rationale: The due list moves with the hot list, which refreshes on its own cadence; every third fire carries the same evidence. 120/weekday -> 40/weekday.
